assumptions: Anchor is 'center' because boxes are top-down with centre as metric position while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge, not ground contact.
All vehicles evaluated are assumed to be approaching a stop sign with a marked limit line, as stop-sign presence is not detectable; zone/line placement provides that context.

Only the marked limit-line case is checked; the 'otherwise before entering the crosswalk' and 'if there is no limit line or crosswalk at the entrance' alternatives have no crosswalk/entrance geometry and are excluded.
Stop is interpreted as remaining continuously stopped (speed <=0.05) inside stop_zone for at least 1000 ms; the statute states no duration.
Inbound approach across stop_line is encoded as direction 'to_right' per line definition (+y is to_right); the statute only says 'approaching'.
No maximum time between stop and crossing is enforced (within_ms null); the statute states no time limit.
Vehicles that never cross the stop line pass vacuously via IMPLIES.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped in the approach waiting zone.

provenance.reason: Boxes are top-down metric positions where centre is metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels/ground contact, so centre is the point zones and lines were drawn for.

provenance.quote: shall stop at a limit line, if marked,

provenance.reason: Statute specifies stop with no duration; 1000 ms continuous stopped dwell required to distinguish a stop from slow roll.
Statute only says 'approaching'; line definition maps inbound/downstream (+y) crossing to to_right, so inbound approach is encoded as to_right.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
